stem:
Alyssa used fraction strips like the ones shown in the diagram in order to find equivalent fractions.

Which list shows only fractions that are equivalent to \( \frac{1}{2} \)?
visual_elements: diagram of fraction strips with 1 whole, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5, 1/6, 1/8 fractions represented
difficulty_rationale: Requires identifying equivalent fractions and understanding of fraction equivalence using visual fraction strips.
